properties.name: Each cue reflow2 gives carries an id, and whether the agent acted on it is counted, so a cue that is never followed can be dropped
properties.source: Anthony Sligar, 2026-10-29: "We can keep (c) with (d) now, then (a)" (option d of the open question on cues)
properties.statement: Every cue reflow2 gives, in a reply or on the agent's side, carries an id, and reflow2 counts whether the agent acted on it (made the call it named, read what it pointed to) within the session. The counts are reported by cue, and a cue that is never followed is a candidate to drop. Only the verb is counted, never the design's content.
